name: Wedge Wipe
description: Two hands sweep away from each other around a point, opening a widening wedge onto the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction the wedge opens from, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

params.name: center
params.description: Point the hands turn around (0..1, y down)
